dispositions.notes: Consumer of cor-potentials-differ-by-a-componentwise-constant. Read in full. Its [L3] restates only the corollary's Statement ('Two potentials of one field differ by a constant on a piecewise-C1 path component'), which the step-8 repair did not touch — the repair was confined to the [L1] Fact. Step 3.1 applies it with the corollary's own U taken to be the open rectangle, which it separately argues is convex and hence star-shaped; a convex open set is joined by segments, so it is a single piecewise-C1 path class and the difference of the two normalized potentials is constant on all of it, then zero by the common normalization at (a,b). That is the DIRECTION the corrected [L1] clause now states ('a nonempty U is itself piecewise-C1 path-connected exactly when it has just one class'). The deleted false direction — that an arbitrary path-connected SUBSET of U is a whole path component of U — is nowhere used here, because the set in question is the whole domain. No change required.

Consumer of cor-potentials-differ-by-a-componentwise-constant. Read in full. Step 1.1 applies the corollary on the common domain U1 n U2, which the Statement assumes nonempty and piecewise-C1 path-connected, to obtain a SINGLE constant C on the whole overlap. That inference needs exactly 'nonempty and path-connected implies one class', which the corrected clause supplies directly; under the old text the same conclusion was reached through a biconditional whose forward half was false. The overlap is used as the corollary's own U, not as a subset of a larger domain, so the false direction was never load-bearing here either. The repair strengthens this consumer's support rather than weakening it. No change required.

Direct-citation and logical consumer of lem-green-type-ii-boundary-identity. Read in full. Its [L3] restates only the lemma's conclusion, 'On a Type II piece, int_{dD_l} Q dy = iint_{D_l} d_x Q dA', which is verbatim the lemma's Statement; the step-8b repair changed no hypothesis, no quantifier and no conclusion of that Statement — it added Facts [L5]-[L8], three published deps, and proof steps 1.3 and 2.2 that supply the Jordan measurability and integrability the old [L3] had wrongly attributed to a vertical-graph theorem. The repair strictly widens what the lemma proves from its cited facts and narrows nothing. Independently, the theorem's [L1] gives every elementary piece BOTH a Type I and a Type II description, so at the point of use the piece's Jordan measurability was already available by the Type I route; the repair removes the lemma's dependence on that coincidence. No change required.

Transitive logical consumer of lem-green-type-ii-boundary-identity through thm-greens-theorem-for-finite-unions-of-elementary-regions; it does not cite the Type II lemma at all. Read in full: its [L1] quotes Green's theorem's Statement and its [L2] quotes def-riemann-integral-over-a-jordan-set, and steps 1.1-1.3 only instantiate P and Q. Nothing in it names a Type II region, a Fact of the Type II lemma, or the region's Jordan measurability by name — that is supplied upstream by lem-green-boundary-cancellation-under-finite-gluing, whose step 3.1 makes the union's boundary content zero and the union Jordan measurable, and which this repair did not touch. No change required.

Transitive logical consumer of lem-green-type-ii-boundary-identity through Green's theorem. Read in full. The remark asserts that the elementary Green theorem applies only with a supplied elementary decomposition and finite gluing data, and neither constructs the interior of an arbitrary Jordan curve nor proves such an interior admits the decomposition. The step-8b repair introduces no Jordan-curve machinery: the three new deps are the Type I/II definition, thm-linear-images-scale-jordan-content-by-absolute-determinant (linear images of Jordan SETS, not Jordan curves) and thm-continuous-functions-on-compact-jordan-sets-are-integrable. The Type II lemma's hypothesis is still a Type II region given by continuous piecewise-C1 lambda <= rho on [c,d]. The stated limitation is unchanged and remains accurate. No change required.
